# What If Dashboard

> A free suite of interactive "what if" calculators and financial planning tools. Users explore scenarios across finance, career, legal, fitness, and productivity — adjusting inputs and instantly seeing projected outcomes.

## Calculators

### Finance
- [Salary & Taxes](/salary) — Model take-home pay across multiple salary scenarios with tax breakdowns.
- [Mortgage Equity](/mortgage) — Project equity growth, amortization, and prepayment impact.
- [Wealth Growth](/investing) — Compound interest and investment growth over time.
- [Goals Tracking](/goals) — Track progress toward multiple savings and financial goals.
- [Debt Repayment](/debt) — Compare avalanche vs. snowball strategies across multiple debts.
- [Emergency Fund Runway](/emergencyfund) — Check if your emergency fund is big enough, see your current runway in months, and project how long it takes to reach your target.
- [FIRE / Retirement Calculator](/fire) — Find your FIRE number and project when you can retire based on savings, contributions, expected return, and planned retirement expenses.
- [Layoff Survival Simulator](/layoffsurvival) — Model how long savings and severance last after a job loss, with runway, burn rate, and what-if scenarios.
- [Lower-Paying Job](/lowerpayingjob) — Compare current salary vs. a lower-paying offer, accounting for benefits and 10-year wealth projections.

### Career
- [Career Path Projection](/careerpath) — Project lifetime earnings across job-hopping vs. staying-put scenarios.

### Legal
- [Bardal Factor](/bardal) — Estimate wrongful dismissal notice periods using Canadian Bardal factors.
- [Wrongful Dismissal](/wrongfuldismissal) — Calculate reasonable notice and damages for wrongful dismissal claims.
- [Severance & EI](/severanceei) — Estimate severance pay and Employment Insurance entitlements after layoff.

### Fitness
- [Weight Loss](/weightloss) — Project weight loss timelines based on calorie deficit and activity.
- [Protein Intake](/protein) — Calculate daily protein targets by body weight and fitness goal.
- [Calorie Deficit Planner](/calorie) — Plan calorie deficits and model fat-loss outcomes.

### Productivity
- [Time Allocation](/time) — Visualize how time is spent across multiple life areas.
- [Days Between](/daysbetween) — Calculate exact days, weeks, and months between two dates.

### Multi-Dashboard
- [Compare Scenarios](/multi) — View and compare outputs from multiple calculators side by side.

## About

All calculators run entirely in the browser — no data is sent to a server. Results are stored locally in the user's browser and can be exported to Markdown or JSON for use with note-taking apps and AI tools.
